clips.title: The story
paras: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore is a local bounty posted in Lakeshire by Magistrate Solomon. It calls on adventurers to hunt down Lieutenant Fangore, the vicious chieftain of the Shadowhide gnolls encroaching upon the Redridge Mountains. Eliminating him strikes a direct blow against the renegade sorcerer Morganth, whom the gnolls serve.

Lakeshire sits in a desperate position. With Stormwind's army stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn mysteriously absent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon has left frontier settlements like Redridge to look after themselves. The Shadowhide clan has grown increasingly bold, raiding trade routes, burning farmsteads, and pressing right up against the town's perimeter. Magistrate Solomon relies on posted bounties to draw mercenary blades where royal soldiers will not march.

Lieutenant Fangore is not merely a marauding beast; he operates as an enforcer for Morganth, a rogue dark wizard lurking in the hills of Redridge. Under Fangore's command, the Shadowhide gnolls coordinate their strikes rather than fighting as disjointed scavengers, threatening to completely sever Lakeshire from Elwynn Forest. Striking off Fangore's paw provides Magistrate Solomon with proof that Morganth's brute vanguard has been broken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth. By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead. Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news do you bring before the Court?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, adventurer. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
